name: sp-review
title_zh: 只评学生自己的课件，不碰职场汇报的审稿人
tagline_zh: 把 PPT 当论文批：逐页打分、标逻辑断点、查引用格式。学生作业答辩够用。
tagline_en: Grades slides like a thesis: per-page scores, logic gaps, citation checks. Built for student defenses, not.
desc_en: Use only for a clearly student-owned academic context when the user explicitly asks to review, audit, score, critique, compare, or diagnose an existing PPT/PPTX/PowerPoint deck or rendered export.
why_zh: 机制上先验明正身：只接学生自有的学术课件。评分维度按学术汇报设计，不套职场模板。
why_en: It verifies the context first: only student-owned academic decks. Scoring rubrics target argumentation, not aesthetics—so.
limit_zh: 只认学生自有的学术 PPT/PPTX 或导出稿；不评职场汇报、商业提案、非学生身份作品。产物是逐页评语与总分。
limit_en: Only reviews student-owned academic PPT/PPTX or exports. No corporate/business decks. Outputs per-slide notes + total score only—no rewriting, no.
title_en: A reviewer that only audits student-owned decks
